3. REMOVE BACK DOOR TRIM BOARD
(a) Remove the tonneau cover hanger.
(b) Using a screwdriver, pry out the clips and remove the back door trim board.
HINT: Tape the screwdriver tip before use.

4. REMOVE LOWER MOULDING
(a) Remove four nuts.
(b) Pry loose two clips with a scraper and remove the moulding.

5. REMOVE LOWER JOINT COVERS

6. REMOVE UPPER MOULDING
(a) Pry loose the clips with a scraper and remove the moulding.
(b) Remove the nozzel from the upper moulding.

7. REMOVE UPPER JOINT COVERS
Remove the clip set screws and joint covers.

8. REMOVE SIDE MOULDING
Using a scraper, pull off the moulding.
